origin.note: Walks 3, 9 and 11 each added a date in their own way; this is the API migration that unifies them, graded by byte-identical output across server time zones.

title: Retire the legacy date helper
objective: src/lib/legacyDate.mjs is deprecated: it formats dates in the server's local time zone, so what customers see depends on where the server runs. Move its remaining callers to src/lib/time.mjs and delete legacyDate.mjs. On a UTC server every page, export, email and key must read exactly as it does today, byte for byte; on a server in any other time zone it must read the same as on UTC. Keep the existing tests passing and add one that proves the time-zone independence.
acceptance: legacyDate.mjs is deleted and nothing imports it
Pages, the audit export, reminder and digest emails and their keys read exactly as before on a UTC server
They read the same on servers in Pacific/Auckland, America/Los_Angeles and Asia/Kolkata
plan_summary: Five callers move to time.mjs equivalents (formatDay, formatShortDay, isoDay, isoMinute, daysBetween, addDays); legacyDate.mjs deleted; docs and the test helper comment updated; a time-zone test.
